english.note: Use this when you specifically mean exemption from customs duty rather than taxes generally.

examples.english: This shipment is duty-free, so we do not have to pay customs duty when it enters the country.
examples.traditional: 呢批貨免關稅，入境嗰陣唔使交關稅。
